target: 100% completion of the selected Windows HD Remaster route, spoiler-free

areas.name: PC Route and Clear-Data Safety
areas.location_cue: The Windows title screen, display settings, control options, and save-slot menu.
areas.note: Establish isolated completion files before chaining bonus modes.

levels.1: Choose the release with the expanded display and control options.
levels.2: Run Resident Evil HD Remaster natively on Windows PC.
levels.3: Install the Windows HD Remaster and begin from its own title screen. Either movement scheme is valid, and no console-exclusive campaign, item, mode, or costume needs a second platform.

levels.1: Later modes depend on how completed files are chained.
levels.2: Keep one clean completion file per character and one shared chain.
levels.3: After each clear, save the completed data into a new slot. Retain isolated Jill and Chris files, plus a separate branch that receives both Normal-or-higher clears; this prevents the dangerous bonus enemy from becoming unavoidable on every replay.

levels.1: The remaster provides two distinct steering styles.
levels.2: Test modern and classic movement before committing to a challenge run.
levels.3: Use an early empty corridor to compare camera-relative modern movement with character-relative classic movement. Pick one before timed, knife-only, or no-save attempts so a mid-run control change does not introduce avoidable mistakes.

levels.1: One playable route carries more inventory and a permanent unlocking tool.
levels.2: Begin a full Jill campaign on the selected difficulty.
levels.3: Finish Jill's route while collecting its exclusive weapon opportunities, file branch, rescue windows, laboratory-cell option, and outcome flags. Save its clear data to a dedicated slot before starting another route.

levels.1: The other route trades inventory space for resilience.
levels.2: Begin a full Chris campaign on the selected difficulty.
levels.3: Finish Chris's route while using Old Keys, his defensive explosive, the temporary medicine section, the study response window, laboratory-cell option, and outcome flags. Preserve this clear separately and on the shared chain.

save_backup.title: Back up before the first clear
save_backup.why: Clear-data chaining can permanently add a hazardous replay modifier.

areas.name: Campaign Routes and Difficulties
areas.location_cue: The new-game selection screens before entering the estate.
areas.note: Complete both character routes and each resource setting.

levels.1: A distinct resource balance changes the complete survival route.
levels.2: Finish a campaign on Very Easy; it is available from a new game.
levels.3: Select Very Easy from an eligible new or clear-data game and reach a completed save. Keep that clear-data file; finishing on a higher setting does not replace the value of experiencing this separate resource layout.

levels.1: A distinct resource balance changes the complete survival route.
levels.2: Finish a campaign on Easy; it is available from a new game.
levels.3: Select Easy from an eligible new or clear-data game and reach a completed save. Keep that clear-data file; finishing on a higher setting does not replace the value of experiencing this separate resource layout.

levels.1: A distinct resource balance changes the complete survival route.
levels.2: Finish a campaign on Normal; it is available from a new game.
levels.3: Select Normal from an eligible new or clear-data game and reach a completed save. Keep that clear-data file; finishing on a higher setting does not replace the value of experiencing this separate resource layout.

levels.1: A distinct resource balance changes the complete survival route.
levels.2: Finish a campaign on Hard; it is unlocked after a completed campaign.
levels.3: Select Hard from an eligible new or clear-data game and reach a completed save. Keep that clear-data file; finishing on a higher setting does not replace the value of experiencing this separate resource layout.

save_backup.title: Keep every completed difficulty file
save_backup.why: Separate clear data protects route-specific unlock conditions.

areas.name: Survival Systems and Full-Map Sweep
areas.location_cue: Any explored room with the inventory, map, health, and defensive-item interfaces available.
areas.note: Master the systems that govern a complete item sweep.

levels.1: Ordinary saves consume a limited field item.
levels.2: Carry an Ink Ribbon to any typewriter to record progress.
levels.3: Stand at a typewriter with at least one Ink Ribbon, interact, and choose a slot. Rotate manual saves before branch decisions; reserve a separate run for the no-save challenge instead of endangering the completion file.

levels.1: Some defeated enemies become more dangerous when left untreated.
levels.2: Decapitate a target or burn its body with kerosene.
levels.3: Fill the Fuel Canteen from a kerosene container, equip the Lighter, and use both beside a fallen body. A decapitating finish also prevents revival. Prioritize central corridors, where repeated travel makes an untreated body most costly.

levels.1: One flame can cover overlapping targets.
levels.2: Drop two enemies so their bodies overlap, then use the Lighter once.
levels.3: Lure two ordinary enemies into the same narrow corridor, defeat them on nearly the same patch of floor, fill the canteen, and ignite one body while both models overlap. Confirm both catch before leaving the camera angle.

levels.1: Color combinations trade immediate healing for stronger recovery or poison treatment.
levels.2: Collect green, red, and blue herbs and test every valid combination.
levels.3: Use green alone, pair green with green, combine green with red, join green with blue, and make the three-color mixture. Blue removes poison; red must be combined and greatly strengthens a green herb.

levels.1: A closed box hides its actual recovery item.
levels.2: Inspect each First Aid Box in the inventory before counting it collected.
levels.3: Highlight the box, choose Examine, rotate it if necessary, and open it. The contained spray or herb becomes a separate inventory object; merely picking up the unopened box does not finish its interaction.

levels.1: The map tracks whether reachable pickups remain.
levels.2: Visit every room and collect every item until each accessible room is green.
levels.3: Acquire every regional map, enter every accessible chamber on both character routes, and inspect the map after clearing each one. Blue or red room shading means an object remains; search all camera angles, containers, shelves, bodies, and puzzle rewards until it turns green.

areas.name: Mansion Key Routes
areas.location_cue: The entrance hall and its first network of dining, gallery, library, and upper corridors.
areas.note: Collect and exhaust every crest key and character-specific unlocking tool.

levels.1: A compact object opens another layer of the estate.
levels.2: Obtain it from upper dining corridor.
levels.3: Search the upper corridor reached from the dining hall and take the Golden Arrow. Examine it in the inventory, remove the Arrowhead, and carry that piece to the outdoor cemetery recess.

levels.1: A compact object opens another layer of the estate.
levels.2: Obtain it from inspect Golden Arrow.
levels.3: Rotate the Golden Arrow in the inventory and detach its stone tip. Place the Arrowhead in the cemetery relief to open the descending route to the crypt.

levels.1: A compact object opens another layer of the estate.
levels.2: Obtain it from Book of Curses rear.
levels.3: Open the cemetery crypt with the Arrowhead, collect the Book of Curses, and inspect its rear cover. Remove the embedded Sword Key, then use it across the first mansion sweep before discarding it.

levels.1: A compact object opens another layer of the estate.
levels.2: Obtain it from armor-trap pedestal.
levels.3: Use the Dog Whistle on the west terrace, take the collar, and inspect it until the imitation key appears. Put that imitation on the moving pedestal while taking the Armor Key so the ceiling trap resets.

levels.1: A compact object opens another layer of the estate.
levels.2: Obtain it from clock puzzle compartment.
levels.3: Complete the piano music, exchange the wall emblems, and place the Gold Emblem in the dining hall. Set the clock to 6:00 and take the Shield Key from the opened compartment.

levels.1: A compact object opens another layer of the estate.
levels.2: Obtain it from Residence arena floor.
levels.3: Complete the Residence route and inspect the item left in the large plant-filled chamber. Use the Helmet Key for the mansion's final locked rooms before discarding it.

levels.1: A compact object opens another layer of the estate.
levels.2: Obtain it from inspect Broach.
levels.3: Open the second Jewelry Box with the Red Gemstone, solve its internal tile arrangement, and inspect the resulting Broach. Convert it into the Emblem Key and use it on the marked mansion door.

levels.1: A compact object opens another layer of the estate.
levels.2: Obtain it from clear-data item box.
levels.3: Load completed clear data and take the Closet Key from an item box. In the first-floor map room, inspect the large painting at the back to reveal the costume closet.

levels.1: A compact object opens another layer of the estate.
levels.2: Obtain it from Chris locked doors.
levels.3: On Chris's route, search side rooms, desks, and small containers for Old Keys. Each opens one plain mansion lock; carry a spare until all corresponding doors have been checked.

levels.1: A compact object opens another layer of the estate.
levels.2: Obtain it from Jill starting tool.
levels.3: Jill receives this reusable tool at the beginning. Try it on simple mansion and Residence locks that do not display a crest-key emblem; unlike Old Keys, it remains available throughout the route.

save_backup.title: Save before taking the displayed shotgun
save_backup.why: One Jill-only interaction requires leaving its replacement behind.

areas.name: Mansion and Courtyard Puzzles
areas.location_cue: The furnished mansion rooms, small cemetery, open courtyard, and stone underground passages.
areas.note: Solve every optional reward puzzle before advancing beyond its region.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the cemetery crypt.
levels.3: Inspect the Golden Arrow to detach the Arrowhead, then fit that stone piece into the cemetery relief. Descend, open the coffin-like fixture, collect the Book of Curses, and inspect its back for the embedded key.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the armor trap.
levels.3: Bring the Imitation of a Key from the dog-collar puzzle. Take the real key from the pedestal, immediately place the imitation in the empty slot, and wait for the moving armor to return before leaving.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the shotgun trap.
levels.3: Take the Broken Shotgun from the side storeroom, enter the shotgun display room, and exchange it for the working weapon. On Jill's separate rescue-variant save, take the weapon without a replacement and attempt to leave.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the clock.
levels.3: After returning the Gold Emblem to the dining-hall recess, inspect the clock. Move the hour hand to six while keeping the minute hand at twelve, confirm 6:00, and take the key from the opened housing.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the piano.
levels.3: Combine the two portions of Missing Music, use the complete score at the piano, and enter the opened alcove. Exchange the wooden Emblem for the Gold Emblem before the passage closes.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the emblem recess.
levels.3: Remove the wooden Emblem from the dining hall before the piano puzzle. Put it into the hidden piano-room recess, take the Gold Emblem, and place that gold piece into the original dining-hall slot.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the specimen case.
levels.3: Take the Fishhook, insect lure, and bee specimen. Combine the Fishhook with the lure, put the completed lure in the display, place the specimen in the opposite case, and press the switch for the Wind Crest.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the tiger statue blue.
levels.3: Insert the Blue Gemstone into the tiger statue's matching eye. Take the ammunition from the revealed compartment, then leave the statue available for the later yellow gemstone.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the tiger statue yellow.
levels.3: After obtaining the Yellow Gemstone from the eagle room, return to the tiger statue and install it in the remaining eye. Collect the exposed MO Disk and retain it for the laboratory terminals.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the death masks.
levels.3: Collect the mask without eyes, without a mouth, without a nose, and without all three features. Match each to the correct cemetery wall fixture, then prepare for the coffin chamber before taking its reward.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the crest tomb.
levels.3: Inspect the backs of the Moon, Star, and Sun Crests so their projections extend. Place all three into the second courtyard tomb, then take the Magnum Revolver from the opened recess.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the courtyard pool.
levels.3: Use the Square Crank at the pool-side mechanism until the water drains. Cross the exposed channel and follow the physical route beyond it; the change cannot be reversed from that crank station.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the courtyard lift.
levels.3: Carry the Battery from the mansion's returning route to the empty courtyard lift socket. Install it, ride upward, and use the nearby crank-and-water route to redirect access to the lower passage.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the cylinder.
levels.3: Collect both parts of the Cylinder Shaft, combine them in the inventory, and insert the complete shaft into the underground control panel. Rotate the display to 4-2-3-1 and confirm the sequence.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the cylinder code.
levels.3: At the underground control panel, set the completed Cylinder Shaft to four, two, three, one. Confirm only after the four symbols match that sequence, then use the restored lift route.

levels.1: A nearby object or inscription supplies the intended interaction.
levels.2: Use the required pieces at the flamethrower bracket.
levels.3: On Chris's underground route, take and use the working Flamethrower only where required. Place the Broken Flamethrower into the wall bracket so its weight releases the exit door.

save_backup.title: Back up before the altar choice
save_backup.why: The offered-item response changes files, weapons, and later outcome flags.

areas.name: Residence and Aqua Ring
areas.location_cue: The detached lodging wing with numbered doors, a gallery, chemical room, and flooded lower level.
areas.note: Clear every numbered room and complete the optional chemical route.

levels.1: The numbered rooms conceal several linked mechanisms.
levels.2: Complete the Room 001 interaction in the Residence.
levels.3: Take the Key for Room 001, unlock the numbered door, and search both the main room and bathroom. Collect the Self Defense Gun and its note separately, then inspect the desk for the route file.

levels.1: The numbered rooms conceal several linked mechanisms.
levels.2: Complete the gallery hive interaction in the Residence.
levels.3: Take the Insecticide Spray, enter the hallway behind the gallery, and use it through the wall opening. Return to the hive, collect the Gallery Key safely, and search the cleared wall for remaining items.

levels.1: The numbered rooms conceal several linked mechanisms.
levels.2: Complete the Room 003 interaction in the Residence.
levels.3: Enter Room 003 with its key, remove the white book from the shelf, and rearrange the colored book spines until they form one continuous picture. Use the newly opened passage only after searching the room.

levels.1: The numbered rooms conceal several linked mechanisms.
levels.2: Complete the aqua controls interaction in the Residence.
levels.3: At the control room, inspect the pressure display, close the safety shutters, and activate the drainage controls. When pressure rises, release it through the correct valve, repeat the shutter sequence, then drain the flooded level.

levels.1: The numbered rooms conceal several linked mechanisms.
levels.2: Complete the V-JOLT interaction in the Residence.
levels.3: Use empty bottles in the chemical room. Mix Water with UMB No.3 for NP-004; add Yellow-6 for UMB No.10. Separately combine UMB No.3 with Yellow-6 for UMB No.7, join those products for VP-017, then add UMB No.3 for V-JOLT.

levels.1: The numbered rooms conceal several linked mechanisms.
levels.2: Complete the V-JOLT use interaction in the Residence.
levels.3: Carry the finished V-JOLT through the drained aqua route to the root room. Apply it directly to the exposed roots; complete this optional weakening step before entering the large plant-filled chamber.

save_backup.title: Back up before entering the large plant-filled room
save_backup.why: A timed support result and optional chemical step affect later content.

areas.name: Underground Laboratory
areas.location_cue: The bright tiled basement with X-ray rooms, computers, power machinery, and numbered security doors.
areas.note: Finish every terminal, file, power, and locked-cell task before using the final lift.

levels.1: The underground rooms link codes, terminals, and power equipment.
levels.2: Complete the laboratory step for x-rays.
levels.3: Collect both X-rays, place CLARK first and GAIL second on the illuminated board, and switch off the room light. Read the emphasized initials in body-part order to derive the nearby access word.

levels.1: The underground rooms link codes, terminals, and power equipment.
levels.2: Complete the laboratory step for x-ray letters.
levels.3: After arranging the two X-rays, read the highlighted initials from the displayed organs. Enter CELL at the matching laboratory terminal when it requests the basement access word.

levels.1: The underground rooms link codes, terminals, and power equipment.
levels.2: Complete the laboratory step for computer login.
levels.3: Use the laboratory computer and enter JOHN as the user name. Continue to the password field, then unlock each available floor option before leaving the terminal.

levels.1: The underground rooms link codes, terminals, and power equipment.
levels.2: Complete the laboratory step for computer password.
levels.3: At the same computer, enter ADA for the password. When the basement lock requests a separate word, use CELL from the X-ray puzzle, then confirm every listed door has been released.

levels.1: The underground rooms link codes, terminals, and power equipment.
levels.2: Complete the laboratory step for MO Disks.
levels.3: Collect all three MO Disks and use one at each pass-code terminal across the laboratory. After all terminals print their codes, operate the three readers beside the secured cell corridor.

levels.1: The underground rooms link codes, terminals, and power equipment.
levels.2: Complete the laboratory step for fuel capsule.
levels.3: Take the empty capsule to the refueling machine and fill it. From then on, walk: do not run, attack, fire, or accept damage. Carry it directly to the power room and install it before resuming combat.

levels.1: The underground rooms link codes, terminals, and power equipment.
levels.2: Complete the laboratory step for slide filter.
levels.3: Collect the Slide Filter, combine or apply it to the slide material, and use the projector in the visual-data room. Inspect every displayed frame and collect any newly revealed object before leaving.

levels.1: The underground rooms link codes, terminals, and power equipment.
levels.2: Complete the laboratory step for fuse unit.
levels.3: Take the Fuse Unit from the laboratory floor and install it in the wall socket beside the final lift controls. Finish every open room and cell-terminal task before calling the lift.

levels.1: The underground rooms link codes, terminals, and power equipment.
levels.2: Complete the laboratory step for signal rockets.
levels.3: Reach the open helipad, take the Signal Rockets from their case, stand in the marked open area, and use them from the inventory. Complete any remaining combat prompt without leaving the pad.

save_backup.title: Back up before operating the three cell readers
save_backup.why: The cell state is one of the late outcome flags.

point_of_no_return.title: Final lift ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Using the powered lift begins the last sequence and closes ordinary exploration.

areas.name: Complete File Archive
areas.location_cue: The file menu and readable surfaces distributed through the estate and laboratory.
areas.note: Confirm every document appears and every multi-part file is complete.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at automatic first key.
levels.3: The first section is added automatically when the first key item enters the inventory; the defense section follows after the first defensive pickup. Open the file menu and read both headings before continuing.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at tea-room body.
levels.3: In the first-floor tea room, inspect the body near the corridor transition and take the film. Much later, use it with the laboratory video player so its viewing also counts.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at cemetery crypt.
levels.3: Place the Arrowhead in the cemetery relief and descend to the crypt. Take the book, inspect and rotate it, remove the Sword Key from its back, then open the file itself.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at hidden piano room.
levels.3: Solve the piano and emblem exchange, enter the hidden room, and inspect the readable journal before leaving with the puzzle reward. Turn every page until the file closes normally.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at with Dog Whistle.
levels.3: Search the second-floor small library and pick up the Dog Whistle. The memo arrives with it automatically; open the file menu afterward to verify its separate entry.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at second-floor small library desk.
levels.3: In the second-floor small library, check the desk opposite the eastern entrance. Read the book before leaving, even if the nearby Dog Whistle was the reason for entering.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at first visited item-box room.
levels.3: Visit either the medical item-box room or east-wing storeroom and read the paper where it spawns. It appears in whichever of those two rooms the current route reaches first, so inspect both arrival surfaces immediately.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at mansion bedroom desk.
levels.3: Enter the mansion bedroom across the short hall from the tiger-statue room. Read the diary on the desk and collect the nearby supplies before disturbing the bed area.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at Residence Room 001.
levels.3: Open Residence Room 001 and inspect its desk area. On any route where another character supplies the file through an interaction, open it from the file menu immediately so the entry is confirmed.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at Helmet-key mansion room.
levels.3: After obtaining the Helmet Key, enter its mansion side room and inspect the table before taking the other valuables. Read the complete letter while still in the room.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at Residence Room 001.
levels.3: Inside Residence Room 001, inspect the surface beneath the Self Defense Gun and read the separate note. Picking up the weapon does not automatically replace this file interaction.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at Residence Room 002 desk.
levels.3: Use the numbered room key for Residence Room 002, then check the desk before opening its bathroom route. Read the report before moving the furniture or entering the adjacent passage.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at Room 003 bookshelf.
levels.3: In Residence Room 003, remove the pale book from the colored bookshelf. Open it as a file before rearranging the remaining spines to form the picture.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at cabin typewriter table.
levels.3: Read all three sections: the cabin table beside its typewriter, the third Jewelry Box in the underground room, and the sarcophagus in the altar chamber. Each inspection extends the same file entry.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at Jill altar branch.
levels.3: On Jill's withheld-gun altar branch, inspect the floor after the chamber interaction and take the photograph. This branch-specific file is unavailable if the gun was returned, so use the backup made before answering.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at laboratory x-ray room.
levels.3: In the first laboratory X-ray room, inspect the table near the computer stations. Read the letter before moving the X-rays to the illuminated board.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at laboratory operating room.
levels.3: Enter the laboratory operating room and examine the computer desk in its northwestern portion. Read the report before collecting the room's ammunition and recovery supplies.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at second x-ray room.
levels.3: In the second X-ray room, examine the shelving near the northeastern desk. Read the fax before arranging or interpreting the medical images.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at laboratory data room shelf.
levels.3: After opening the laboratory's data route, inspect the shelf inside the visual-data area before using its projector. Read the protocols before inserting the Slide Filter.

levels.1: Readable material is usually beside a key route object or workstation.
levels.2: Read it at central laboratory floor.
levels.3: After the central laboratory encounter has fully ended, search the floor beside the main control console. Read the note before leaving through the newly available route.

save_backup.title: Preserve a save before the altar response
save_backup.why: One photograph exists only on Jill's withheld-item branch.

areas.name: Complete Arsenal
areas.location_cue: Item boxes and weapon pickups across both character routes.
areas.note: Acquire every standard, route-specific, branch, and timed weapon.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from starting inventory.
levels.3: Open Jill's initial inventory and retain the knife. Equip it and land at least one hit, then use this exact route for the knife-only clear without firing, burning enemies, or triggering defensive weapons.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from starting inventory.
levels.3: Open Chris's initial inventory and retain the knife. Equip it at least once; its campaign copy must be used for Chris-route collection even if Jill's equivalent was already recorded.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from character route acquisition.
levels.3: Acquire the route's Handgun, load a magazine, and fire it successfully. Repeat on both playable routes because their opening possession and inventory circumstances differ.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from mansion shotgun room.
levels.3: Take the Broken Shotgun to the mansion display room and swap it for the working Shotgun. On a separate Jill branch, deliberately omit the replacement and attempt to leave for the alternate trap interaction.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from preserve Richard branch.
levels.3: Complete the timed serum support successfully, continue through the corresponding upper-mansion route, and collect the upgraded shotgun when it becomes available. Missing that support window removes this weapon from the current clear.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from Jill terrace route.
levels.3: On Jill's route, search the outdoor upper terrace reached from the mansion corridor and take the launcher. Load and fire standard, acid, and incendiary shells at least once each.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from Residence Room 001.
levels.3: Unlock Residence Room 001 and take the small single-shot weapon from its surface. Also read the note beneath it; the gun has only one loaded round and cannot be replenished.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from crest tomb.
levels.3: Inspect the backs of the Moon, Star, and Sun Crests, insert all three into the second courtyard tomb, and take the revolver. Load it with Magnum Rounds before recording a successful shot.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from Chris underground route.
levels.3: On Chris's underground route, take the working Flamethrower from its wall bracket and use it only across the required section. Return or exchange the correct unit at the exit mechanism so the route remains open.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from Jill withheld-gun branch.
levels.3: On Jill's altar branch, withhold the offered gun and collect the heavy revolver after the interaction. This choice changes later route flags, so preserve the pre-choice save and finish this weapon branch separately.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from final arena supply.
levels.3: During the final open-air arena, collect the supplied launcher and use it on the active target before the timer expires. This story-use copy is distinct from the unlimited clear-time reward.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from five-hour unlock.
levels.3: Finish Once Again on Normal or Hard with the completion clock below five hours. Load that clear data and verify the unlimited three-round-burst handgun appears in the starting inventory or item box.

levels.1: The full arsenal spans both routes and timed clear data.
levels.2: Acquire it from three-hour unlock.
levels.3: Finish Once Again on Normal or Hard in less than three hours. Load the resulting clear data and verify the unlimited launcher is present; it cannot be taken into Real Survival.

save_backup.title: Separate the weapon branches
save_backup.why: Several weapons require mutually exclusive route flags or timed clears.

areas.name: Ammunition and Defensive Items
areas.location_cue: Supply shelves, containers, bodies, and item boxes throughout explored rooms.
areas.note: Record every ammunition family and both character-specific defenses.

levels.1: Search item rooms and containers for every supply category.
levels.2: Collect and use at least one Handgun Magazine.
levels.3: Search both character routes until Handgun Magazine has entered the inventory. If it is ammunition, load or fire one compatible weapon; if it is a defensive item, allow one ordinary grab and trigger that defense once on its eligible character.

levels.1: Search item rooms and containers for every supply category.
levels.2: Collect and use at least one Shotgun Shells.
levels.3: Search both character routes until Shotgun Shells has entered the inventory. If it is ammunition, load or fire one compatible weapon; if it is a defensive item, allow one ordinary grab and trigger that defense once on its eligible character.

levels.1: Search item rooms and containers for every supply category.

areas.name: Challenge Clears and Special Interactions
areas.location_cue: Fresh-game and clear-data selections used for restricted or timed playthroughs.
areas.note: Run each restriction separately unless the combination is already comfortable.

levels.1: A dedicated run or controlled interaction records this play style.
levels.2: Complete the knife only condition on a suitable save.
levels.3: Start a fresh eligible campaign and use only the Survival Knife for player attacks. Do not fire weapons, use defensive items, ignite bodies with the Lighter, or accept an automatic head stomp. Finish and preserve the clear data separately.

levels.1: A dedicated run or controlled interaction records this play style.
levels.2: Complete the no save condition on a suitable save.
levels.3: Begin a fresh campaign, never confirm a typewriter save, and complete it in one continuous session. Pause menus are safe, but quitting loses progress; use a stable system and avoid combining this attempt with an unfamiliar difficulty.

levels.1: A dedicated run or controlled interaction records this play style.
levels.2: Complete the full map condition on a suitable save.
levels.3: Collect every regional map, enter every accessible room, and remove every pickup until the map marks each room green. Repeat on the other character because exclusive doors, objects, and route interactions differ.

levels.1: A dedicated run or controlled interaction records this play style.
levels.2: Complete the all weapons condition on a suitable save.
levels.3: Acquire every standard, character-exclusive, branch-exclusive, story-use, and timed-unlock weapon. Load the corresponding clear data and verify each reward, then use every ordinary weapon at least once.

levels.1: A dedicated run or controlled interaction records this play style.
levels.2: Complete the launcher shells condition on a suitable save.
levels.3: On Jill's route, collect standard grenade, acid, and incendiary ammunition. Load the Grenade Launcher with each variety in turn and fire one successful shot before discarding or storing that shell type.

levels.1: A dedicated run or controlled interaction records this play style.
levels.2: Complete the double burn condition on a suitable save.
levels.3: Defeat two ordinary enemies so their bodies overlap, fill the Fuel Canteen, equip the Lighter, and ignite the shared position. Stay in view long enough to confirm both bodies burn from the single use.

levels.1: A dedicated run or controlled interaction records this play style.
levels.2: Complete the shotgun rescue condition on a suitable save.
levels.3: On Jill's route, enter the shotgun display room without placing the Broken Shotgun, take the working gun, and try to leave. Complete the resulting escape interaction, then preserve this run or restore the earlier backup for the standard exchange.

levels.1: A dedicated run or controlled interaction records this play style.

levels.3: On Jill's route, answer the medicine request immediately, run directly to the medical item-box room, take the Serum, and return without detours. Complete the handoff before the hidden window closes to preserve its later weapon opportunity.

levels.1: A dedicated run or controlled interaction records this play style.

levels.3: On Chris's route, allow the applicable upper-mansion encounter to inflict poison and complete the temporary playable medicine section. Retrieve the Serum from the medical room and return through the shortest unlocked route before its timer expires.

save_backup.why: Restricted runs can invalidate themselves without an immediate warning.

areas.name: Legacy Secrets and Presentation Extras
areas.location_cue: An item box, laboratory computer, and post-clear title menus.
areas.note: Use disposable saves for the inventory exploit and retain clean clear data.

levels.1: A precise item-box arrangement exposes a legacy inventory quirk.
levels.2: Use Jill, an empty inventory, the launcher, and one matching shell stack.
levels.3: Make a disposable Jill save. Empty the inventory, put the Grenade Launcher in the upper-left slot and compatible shells in the upper-right, equip the launcher, then use the item box to place and reload the same shell type through its default position. Confirm the launcher displays the enlarged count; never carry this exploit into a clean challenge file.

levels.1: An unused legacy password produces a small audiovisual response.
levels.2: At a laboratory computer, test MOLE before the real login.
levels.3: Before entering the functional credentials at the laboratory computer, submit MOLE in the password field used by the older release. Watch and listen to the brief easter-egg response, then clear the field and continue with the proper login sequence.

levels.1: A completed file changes the main menu presentation.
levels.2: Save a completed campaign and return to the title screen.
levels.3: Finish either character route, write the clear data, and allow the game to return to its menus normally. Reload or restart to the title screen and wait through its full idle presentation to confirm the post-clear variant appears.

save_backup.title: Use a disposable glitch file
save_backup.why: The ammunition exploit should not contaminate clean completion records.
